roomTypes.name: The Hollow
roomTypes.description: A single, windowless-feeling cocoon carved for those who wish to disappear entirely — even from their own itinerary. Charcoal limewash walls absorb sound; a single shaft of light falls across the room at dawn and vanishes by ten. There is no minibar, no television, no clock. Aetheris removes what most resorts add, so that solitude has nothing left to compete with.

roomTypes.name: The Obsidian Chamber
roomTypes.description: Named for the volcanic stone that lines its private bath, the Obsidian Chamber sits half-sunken into the hillside so that no window meets another window. A recessed plunge pool of black granite mirrors the night sky. Guests are given no reason to look outward — only inward.

roomTypes.name: The Ember Suite
roomTypes.description: A private hearth burns without smoke or sound behind reinforced glass, its glow the only source of light after dusk. The Ember Suite is reserved for guests who wish to be warmed, not entertained — a room built entirely around the absence of urgency.

roomTypes.name: The Vantage Loft
roomTypes.description: Elevated above the treeline on stilts of blackened steel, the Vantage Loft offers a single, uninterrupted view of the valley below and nothing else — no neighboring structure has ever entered its sightline, and none ever will.

roomTypes.name: The Stillwater Villa
roomTypes.description: A private villa built around a courtyard of unmoving black water, so still it is often mistaken for stone. Two bedrooms open onto the courtyard independently, allowing guests to share proximity without ever sharing presence — togetherness on one's own terms.

roomTypes.name: The Ashwood Residence
roomTypes.description: A three-bedroom residence of ash-grey timber and stone, designed for families or retinues who require space between them as much as shelter above them. A private staff entrance ensures the household is served without ever being seen.

roomTypes.name: The Monolith Penthouse
roomTypes.description: Occupying the retreat's highest point, the Monolith is a single slab of dark concrete and glass that appears, from any distance, to be uninhabited. Inside, every surface has been chosen to disappear at night, leaving only the guest and the horizon.

roomTypes.name: The Sanctum
roomTypes.description: A standalone estate at the farthest edge of the property, reachable only by private escort. The Sanctum is the only accommodation at Aetheris with its own perimeter, its own staff quarters, and its own silence — an entire world reserved for a single party.

menuItems.name: Midnight Caviar Spoon
menuItems.description: A single spoon of Osetra caviar over potato blini and crème fraîche, finished with one shard of edible gold. Served alone, on a black slate, with nothing beside it.

menuItems.name: Charred Bone Marrow & Black Truffle
menuItems.description: Roasted marrow bone split tableside, finished with shaved black truffle and a whisper of smoked sea salt. Eaten with nothing but a spoon and silence.

menuItems.name: Hokkaido Scallop, Ash-Roasted
menuItems.description: Diver scallop roasted in hearth ash, served in its own shell over a pool of brown butter and yuzu kosho.

menuItems.name: Smoked Wild Mushroom Consommé
menuItems.description: A clarified broth of foraged mushrooms, smoked over embers for six hours and poured tableside from a blackened kettle.

menuItems.name: Dry-Aged Wagyu, Ember-Seared
menuItems.description: A5 wagyu, dry-aged sixty days and seared directly over open ember, sliced tableside and served without garnish — the ingredient is the entire statement.

menuItems.name: Whole Roasted Turbot, Champagne Butter
menuItems.description: Whole turbot roasted on the bone and finished tableside with a champagne beurre blanc, deboned in front of the guest.

menuItems.name: Squab en Croûte with Foie Gras
menuItems.description: Roasted squab wrapped in foie gras and pastry, rested and carved in the room, paired with a reduction of aged port.

menuItems.name: Dark Chocolate & Gold Dust Sphere
menuItems.description: A sphere of 72% dark chocolate that dissolves at the table under a pour of warm salted caramel, dusted with edible gold.

menuItems.name: Champagne Sabayon with Black Fig
menuItems.description: A warm, airy sabayon whisked with vintage champagne, served over roasted black figs and toasted hazelnut.

menuItems.name: Aetheris Reserve Champagne
menuItems.description: A single vintage bottle, cellared exclusively for Aetheris and released to no other property in the world.

menuItems.name: Single-Origin Kyoto Matcha Ceremony
menuItems.description: A formal, silent matcha preparation performed tableside using ceremonial-grade leaves from a single Kyoto estate.

menuItems.name: 25-Year Single Malt, Neat
menuItems.description: A quarter-century single malt from a private cask, poured neat and left to breathe in silence before service.

menuItems.name: The Stillness Tasting Menu
menuItems.description: A seven-course progression built around absence rather than abundance — each course simpler than the last, ending in a single unadorned course meant to be eaten in complete silence.

amenities.name: Private Chef In-Suite Dining
amenities.description: A dedicated chef prepares and serves a personalized multi-course dinner entirely within your suite, so that even the dining room becomes unnecessary.

amenities.name: Personal Butler Service (24hr)
amenities.description: A single, permanently assigned butler attends to every need for the duration of your stay, communicating only when spoken to.

amenities.name: Helicopter Transfer
amenities.description: Direct, private helicopter transfer between Aetheris and the nearest discreet airfield, bypassing all public arrival points.

amenities.name: Private Yacht Charter (Half-Day)
amenities.description: A crewed private yacht reserved exclusively for your party, departing from Aetheris's unmarked private dock.

amenities.name: Floatation Sensory Deprivation Therapy
amenities.description: A private session in a sealed floatation chamber, removing sound, light, and gravity to return the mind to true stillness.

amenities.name: In-Suite Spa & Massage
amenities.description: A full therapeutic massage delivered entirely within your suite by a private therapist, using oils blended for your stay alone.

amenities.name: Private Wine Cellar Tasting
amenities.description: An exclusive after-hours tasting inside Aetheris's subterranean cellar, guided by the resident sommelier for your party only.

amenities.name: Digital Detox Concierge
amenities.description: A dedicated concierge takes custody of all devices for the duration of your stay and curates an entirely offline itinerary in their place.

amenities.name: Stargazing & Telescope Session
amenities.description: A private astronomer guides a late-night observation session using Aetheris's observatory-grade telescope, far from any ambient light.

amenities.name: Private Cinema Screening
amenities.description: The resort's single-screen cinema reserved entirely for your party, with any film sourced and screened on request.

amenities.name: Meditation & Sound Bath Session
amenities.description: A private, guided meditation and sound bath performed with hand-forged singing bowls, held in the resort's stone chamber.

amenities.name: Executive Protection Detail (Per Day)
amenities.description: A discreet, professionally trained security detail assigned solely to your party, present but never visible.

amenities.name: Falconry Experience
amenities.description: A private falconry session on the resort's private grounds, led by a resident falconer, held at dawn when the grounds are entirely empty.

amenities.name: Private Art Curator Tour
amenities.description: A one-on-one walkthrough of Aetheris's private art collection, guided by a resident curator, arranged exclusively around your schedule.
